title: This MSFS AI Copilot just went FREE (and it actually listens)
description:
Sim Copilot version 1.1 completely overhauls the virtual first officer experience in Microsoft Flight Simulator and the core tool is now permanently free for everyone.

No more expiring trials, rigid XML syntax, or robotic Windows system voices. Version 1.1 introduces a Natural Commands Resolver that understands phrasing variations ("drop the gear", "wheels out"), an AI Command Builder to create entire flows in plain English, and 13 lifelike neural voices with seamless offline fallback.

Whether you fly in VR or just want to keep your hands on the yoke without wrestling with menus, here is everything new in this update.

✈️ What you'll see in this video:
0:00 - Intro
0:30 - Permanent Free tier & lifetime pricing
1:14 - Natural Commands Resolver (testing phrasing)
1:56 - AI Command Builder: plain-English flows
2:24 - Neural Voices vs. Default Audio & Fallback
3:02 - Final Verdict: Is It Essential for VR?
